messages:
Maya R.: Morning team, first day here! Laptop delivered but tracker says monitor + dock were left at 'Front Desk' and I don't see them at 4F-11. Also can't join 'Redwood-Staff' Wi-Fi, getting '802.1X: authentication failed'. Filed ticket #6129 but adding IT here.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #6129 received and assigned to Liam (IT). Expected response within ~30 minutes. If urgent, mention @Liam (IT). :robot_face:

Liam (IT): Welcome @Maya R.! Can you paste the carrier tracking number? For the Wi-Fi, try 'Redwood-Guest' and use the onboarding email link for a temporary token. What OS are you on?

Maya R.: Tracking ZX123456789US, status "Delivered to Front Desk" at 09:12. I'm on macOS 13.5.1.

George - Facilities: Hi Maya, package ZX123456789US is on Mailroom shelf B under "New Hires." I can deliver to 4F in ~20 minutes or you can pick up. :package:

Sophia T.: If you need a temporary dongle, I have a spare USB-C hub you can borrow. I can leave it at 4F-11. :smile:

Liam (IT): Try the guest network now. On mac, if Wi-Fi misbehaves run in Terminal:
networksetup -setairportpower en0 off
sleep 2
networksetup -setairportpower en0 on
Then try joining. If an 802.1X prompt appears, choose "Use System" and enter your SSO email + the guest token. If you can't find the token, I'll DM it.

Maya R.: Ran that, still see 802.1X popup and it won't accept my corp password. I don't see any guest token in the onboarding email. Can you DM?

Liam (IT): DMing guest token now. Also escalating to Network; pushing a cert refresh.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Note: escalated to Network team (ticket NW-277).

Liam (IT): Network confirmed cert refresh pushed for your account. Try reconnecting.

Maya R.: Connected! :tada: George just dropped off the monitor and dock too, thanks. Do I need to register the dock anywhere?

Liam (IT): No registration. Dock should be plug-and-play. If monitor doesn't wake, in System Settings -> Displays hold Option and click "Detect Displays", or run:
sudo killall -HUP WindowServer
If you want, I can remote in for a quick check.

Sophia T.: Welcome again @Maya R.! See you at the 4F stand-up.

Maya R.: Thanks everyone, appreciating the warm welcome :heart:
